# Dev Narsinghani

> Dev Narsinghani is a creative strategist for honest food brands, based in Mumbai, India. He makes honest food easy to choose and builds his own AI tools for content and growth.

## Facts
- Full name: Dev Narsinghani. From Bhopal, lives in Mumbai.
- Career: Chief of Staff at Food Pharmer and founding team at OWN; Brand Marketing Manager at Troovy (kids' nutrition); Grant Thornton (NHAI team); Indus Insights; Sploot.
- Education: B.Com (Hons), Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC), University of Delhi, Rank 4.
- Cleared the NDA exam in the top 0.1% of 5.7 lakh+ candidates, the only commerce student to qualify.
- Topics: creative strategy, content strategy, food labels, nutrition marketing, sleep, AI for marketing.
